description: This file contains the implementation of the GoogleCalendarProvider class, which manages integration with Google Calendar within the SuiteCRM application. It handles OAuth authentication, fetching, creating, updating, and deleting calendar events, as well as testing the connection to Google Calendar API.

classes.name: GoogleCalendarProvider
classes.description: A class that provides integration with Google Calendar API, including OAuth handling, event synchronization, and calendar management.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to Google Calendar and returns the result as a CalendarConnectionTestResult object.

methods.name: testGoogleCalendarConnection
methods.description: Performs the actual connection test to Google Calendar API, initializing services and verifying access.

methods.name: initializeGoogleServices
methods.description: Sets up Google Client and Calendar Service objects for API interaction, reusing existing initialized objects if available.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves and refreshes the OAuth access token as needed, throwing exceptions if not available or refresh fails.

methods.name: getOAuthConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the ExternalOAuthConnection object associated with a given CalendarAccount.

methods.name: getOrCreateSuiteCRMCalendar
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Calendar on Google Calendar with a specific name used by SuiteCRM, returning its ID.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Fetches events from Google Calendar within a specified date range, converting them to internal CalendarAccountEvent objects.

methods.name: convertFromGoogleEvent
methods.description: Converts a Google_Service_Calendar_Event object into a CalendarAccountEvent instance, extracting custom extended properties.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a single event by its ID, returning a CalendarAccountEvent or null if not found or cancelled.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new Google Calendar event from a CalendarAccountEvent object and returns the event's ID.

methods.name: convertToGoogleEvent
methods.description: Converts a CalendarAccountEvent into a Google_Service_Calendar_Event object for API insertion or update.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing Google Calendar event based on a CalendarAccountEvent.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a Google Calendar event by its ID.
